item.statement: Conventional eutectic high entropy alloys suffer from room-temperature brittleness and limited tensile ductility, hindering practical usage.

item.statement: Traditional eutectic high entropy alloys exhibit incoherent interfaces with transition layers that cause strain localization and interfacial cracking.
quotes: a transition layer with a thickness of ~10 nm between the FCC and B2 phases was identified in the lamellae structure
Similar incoherent interface has been frequently reported in eutectic high entropy alloys and recognized as the origin of strain localization
pronounced dislocation pile-ups are routinely developed in the vicinity of internal boundaries, where local stress concentration can emerge
